outfits.title: The weekend stripe
outfits.image_credit: Credits on original article; runway images credited there to Launchmetrics Spotlight
outfits.notes: A strong stripe, straight denim and tan loafers. Try a relaxed top with a clean break at the ankle. The photograph shows inspiration; the linked pieces are proposed equivalents.

outfits.title: Off duty, dialed in
outfits.image_credit: Credits on original article; runway images credited there to Launchmetrics Spotlight
outfits.notes: Let a track jacket loosen up the trousers. Keep the tee plain so the silhouette and stripe do the work.

outfits.title: A little mountain air
outfits.image_credit: Credits on original article; runway images credited there to Launchmetrics Spotlight
outfits.notes: Make the sweater the interesting part. Add dark jeans and simple brown boots; skip extra patterns at first.

outfits.title: The easy collegiate
outfits.image_credit: Credits on original article; runway images credited there to Launchmetrics Spotlight
outfits.notes: A pale oxford under a cotton cardigan, grounded by olive chinos. Leave a little collar showing.

outfits.title: After the last set
outfits.notes: Brown leather and faded black denim with a cream tee. The pictured dark layers suggest proportion, rather than an exact copy.

outfits.title: Denim, dressed a little
outfits.notes: Pair a denim jacket with a fine knit polo and proper trousers. Keep the shoes quiet.

outfits.title: A softer kind of sharp
outfits.image_credit: Credits on original article; runway images credited there to Launchmetrics Spotlight
outfits.notes: Soft shoulders, a pale blue shirt and straight charcoal trousers. Try the shirt open at the neck.

outfits.title: No meeting required
outfits.notes: A fine crewneck and short wool jacket make tailoring feel easy. Use the street reference to compare length and drape.

outfits.title: Quiet texture
outfits.image_credit: Daniele Oberrauch / Gorunway.com, via Vogue Runway
outfits.notes: Pale blue and stone under a soft brown jacket. Texture carries the interest, with simple sneakers below.

outfits.title: Cocoa after hours
outfits.image_credit: Daniele Oberrauch / Gorunway.com, via Vogue Runway
outfits.notes: Keep the color shifts close and let the long outer layer change the shape. A lightweight mac works on milder days.

outfits.title: One good going out shirt
outfits.image_credit: Credits on original article; runway images credited there to Launchmetrics Spotlight
outfits.notes: A textured plum shirt and black denim. Try sheen, a subtle weave or an open collar before a more decorative top.

outfits.title: Color, with an anchor
outfits.image_credit: Courtesy of Dries Van Noten; see official show page for full credits
outfits.notes: Anchor a colorful striped knit with black trousers and a plain coat. Start with one expressive piece.
